locations.label: Elevator Fuse
locations.description: Shoot a zombie body in the library to collect the fuse.

locations.label: Elevator Circuit Board
locations.description: Shoot Rictofen's computer to eject a circuit board.

locations.label: Elevator
locations.description: Repair the elevator from the back side and use it to reach the mainframe chamber.

locations.label: Lab Technician Zombie
locations.description: Lab Technician search area in Service Tunnel / Mainframe Chamber. The named zombie drops the floppy disk; its movement is not fixed to this marker.

locations.label: Fax Machine
locations.description: Insert the floppy disk near the T-Rex skeleton in East Foyer and defend it to print Project Janus paper.

locations.label: Nursery Room Chalkboard
locations.description: Convert the four-letter word into a four-digit code and input it on the keypad in the Service Tunnel.

locations.label: Service Tunnel Keypad
locations.description: Input the code to unlock the glass door, kill the Doppelgast, and retrieve the severed arm.

locations.label: Raygun Keypad
locations.description: Use the severed arm to unlock the Ray Gun Mk2.

locations.label: Yellow Mk2 R Canister
locations.description: Throw a Kazimir Grenade at a window barrier behind Double Tap to pull in the canister.

locations.label: Conservatory Charging Spot
locations.description: Place the canister, and then plant and charge 4 seeds from the 4 plants around the map (Use explosives on them) to charge the Toxic Canister for Mk2 R.

locations.label: Yellow Library Liminal Space
locations.description: Open the liminal space by interacting with the machine to the left, then kill zombies with the Yellow Mk2 R, talk to ghost Colton, and retrieve blue books on the east side of the map using Aether Shroud.

locations.label: Hidden Vault
locations.description: The door to the vault that will open after collecting the 3 blue aether books and activating them in the correct order, indicated by the order of books in the yellow liminal space.

locations.label: Yellow Ritual
locations.description: After obtaining the Nuclear Plant Inspection Report, return here to start a mini bossfight that requires the Yellow Mk2 R to beat the boss and complete 1 of 3 rituals.

locations.label: Blue Crystal
locations.description:
1 of 4 total crystals around the map, visible with death perception, that can be shot with the Ray Gun Mk2 and will drop scrap and one of them will drop the canister needed for one of the Mk2 W Upgrade.
Conservatory Roof.
locations.conditions: Possible location; the active spawn or chosen site depends on the current run.

locations.description:

locations.label: Shems Henge Charging Spot
locations.description: Place the canister, lure Abominations to charge blue rocks with a beam attack, then have them bash into the rocks with their charge attack. Once the rocks are floating, defend the power siphon from vermin.

locations.label: Sconce
locations.description: Found in a box in the banquet room, just before getting to the elevator. Used to open the distillery.

locations.label: Hidden Distillery Room
locations.description: Use the sconce to start the Simon Says puzzle and access the Distillery.

locations.label: Blue Distillery Liminal Space
locations.description: Open the liminal space by interacting with the machine to the left, then kill zombies with the Blue Mk2 W near it, to open it.

locations.label: Service Bell
locations.description: Can be found around the study hallway, in a display cabinet, or on a table or the floor. Must be placed at the bar in the grand foyer and rang after brain-rotting a zombie near it.
locations.conditions: Possible location; the active spawn or chosen site depends on the current run.

locations.label: Bar
locations.description: Where you obtain the Hip Flask, place the service bell and then brain rot a zombie nearby, ring the bell after brain rotting. (Bell can also be rung 115 times to obtain a free perk)

locations.label: Blue Ritual
locations.description: After obtaining the Hip Flask, return here to start a mini bossfight that requires the Blue Mk2 W to beat the boss and complete 1 of 3 rituals.

locations.label: Purple Mk2 P Canister
locations.description: Use Tomahawks on gas valves and shatter glass chamber with fire/exposives in the Mainframe Chamber to retrieve the canister.

locations.label: Gas Valves
locations.description: Depending on the letter displayed by the chamber, hit the middle and then corresponding letter valve, with the tomahawks in order to guide the gas to the chamber.

locations.label: Reflector
locations.description: Used in the serpent mount puzzle, found in dried up fountains around the map.

locations.label: Reflector
locations.description: Used in the serpent mount puzzle, found in dried up fountains around the map.

locations.label: Serpent Mound - Entrance Rubble
locations.description: A wall of rubble that must be removed with a yellow bomb that can be found in any of the Project Janus boxes around the map.

locations.label: Serpent Mound Charging Spot
locations.description: Place the canister, charge it by killing doppleghasts, spawned by solving the reflector puzzle in the room.

locations.label: Banquet Hall Liminal Space
locations.description: Open the liminal space by interacting with the machine to the left, then kill zombies with the Purple Mk2 P. Then retrieve the code for the antler carving from the safe in West Hallway by completing the chalice rituals and returning to the area around the elevator.

locations.label: Ritual Chalice
locations.description:
1 of 3 total chalices around the map, that can be interacted with after obtaining the Ritual Elixir from the Purple Banquet Hall liminal space.
On the stone bench at spawn.

locations.label: Ritual Chalice
locations.description:
1 of 3 total chalices around the map, that can be interacted with after obtaining the Ritual Elixir from the Purple Banquet Hall liminal space.
On a table in the wine cellar.

locations.label: Ritual Chalice
locations.description:
1 of 3 total chalices around the map, that can be interacted with after obtaining the Ritual Elixir from the Purple Banquet Hall liminal space.
On a wooden bench above the entrance to the mansion, on the overlook.

locations.label: Safe
locations.description: Contains the Antler Carving, requires the code from the walls after doing the chalice ritual.

locations.label: Purple Ritual
locations.description: After obtaining the Antler Carving, return here to start a mini bossfight that requires the Purple Mk2 P to beat the boss and complete 1 of 3 rituals.

locations.label: SAM AI Platform
locations.description:
A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.
After completing all 3 rituals, you can initiate the final boss fight by interacting with the platform.

locations.label: Mr Peeks Headphones
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song.
On a box by the stairs in the conservatory.

locations.label: Mr Peeks Headphones
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song.
Behind the elevator on a shelf in the corner.

locations.label: Mr Peeks Headphones
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song.
On a box behind a burnt body.

locations.label: Max Ammo
locations.description: On the corner of a stone fence.

locations.label: Max Armour
locations.description: Speared on the fence behind the burning building in the motor court.

locations.label: Insta Kill
locations.description: Up on the eastern wall of the elevator shaft.

locations.label: Double Points
locations.description: Off in the distance near a log.

locations.label: Full Power
locations.description: On the zombie windowframe, only visible if you go prone and look through the hole in the wall.

locations.label: Nuke
locations.description: On top of the white room, will need to climb on the box opposite to see.

locations.label: Bonus Points
locations.description: In a hole in the wall by the stairs.

locations.label: Fire Sale
locations.description: Only appears after shooting all 7 other power ups. Hidden inside the chandelier.

locations.label: Sleep Walking Egg - Clock
locations.description: Start here at the grandfather clock at round 11, interact with the clock, then go to the bed and progress the round to round 12.

locations.label: Sleep Walking Egg - Bed
locations.description: Go prone on this bed after interacting with the clock on round 11 and transition the round. When you wake up you'll need to follow the white footsteps to be led to the loot, including an intel document.

locations.label: Deer Head Shotgun Egg
locations.description: You can start a soul box easter egg mini game after placing a blue or better rarity shotgun on the pedestal under the 3 deer heads. The can be done multiple times.

locations.label: Jumpscare Egg
locations.description: Requires a thermal scope, progress to round 13 and look through the windows on the outside of the mansion until you spot a figure that will disappear when looked at. Do this 5 times to then be able to access this mirror and get your reward. Including a document intel item.

locations.label: Wunderwaffe DG-2 - Start
locations.description:
The start of the free Wunderwaffe Side Egg. Will not spawn until you have obtained at least 1 elemental raygun variant.
Underneath the bed, first one to spawn.

locations.label: Wunderwaffe DG-2 - Orb Step
locations.description:
1 of 3 glowing purple items, that when shot, spawn an orb that needs to have the items around it destroyed, after doing all 3 the Wunderwaffe will be collectable.
On a green chair opposite elemental pop, only spawns after shooting the glowing clothes.

locations.label: Wunderwaffe DG-2 - Orb Step
locations.description:
1 of 3 glowing purple items, that when shot, spawn an orb that needs to have the items around it destroyed, after doing all 3 the Wunderwaffe will be collectable.
On top of some rocks by spawn.

locations.label: Wunderwaffe DG-2 - Orb Step
locations.description:
1 of 3 glowing purple items, that when shot, spawn an orb that needs to have the items around it destroyed, after doing all 3 the Wunderwaffe will be collectable.
Sat on a bench on the ground floor of the grand foyer.

locations.label: Wunderwaffe DG-2 - Finish
locations.description: After destroying all 3 floating purple masses, come here and shoot the purple smoke to drop the weapon.

locations.label: S.A.M Trap - Computer
locations.description: 1 of 3 computers that can be interacted with, if you interact with one and end the round it will indicate if it was infected and then can be interacted with again to obtain a hard drive.

locations.label: S.A.M Trap - Computer
locations.description: 1 of 3 computers that can be interacted with, if you interact with one and end the round it will indicate if it was infected and then can be interacted with again to obtain a hard drive.

locations.label: S.A.M Trap - Computer
locations.description: 1 of 3 computers that can be interacted with, if you interact with one and end the round it will indicate if it was infected and then can be interacted with again to obtain a hard drive.

locations.label: S.A.M Trap Egg
locations.description: After obtaining the hard drive from the computers and without ending the round, interact with this computer to activate the S.A.M trap easter egg.

targets.title: Fuse → circuit board → elevator
targets.description: Library zombie → Fuse; Director’s computer → Circuit Board; repair Banquet Hall elevator.

targets.title: Perks & upgrade services
targets.description: Equip Aether Shroud; reserve Brain Rot, a Kazimir, Combat Axes and an explosive.

targets.title: Technician search area & fax machine
targets.description: Round 10+: Lab Technician → disk → East Foyer computer → printed protocol.

targets.title: Nursery clue → Service Tunnel keypad → Ray Gun case
targets.description: Count each protocol letter’s full cluster → cell keypad → Doppelghast arm → Armory Mark II.

targets.title: Four blue-crystal canister candidates
targets.description: Base Mark II → four blue-crystal locations → collect one empty canister.

targets.title: Rear Patio Kazimir canister
targets.description: Kazimir in front of the Rear Patio window → collect extracted canister.

targets.title: Mainframe gas valves & chamber
targets.description: Read tube letter → axe the closed feed valve and matching A/B valve → explode filled tube.

targets.title: Shem’s Henge charger & W workbench
targets.description: Henge: beam then charge three rocks → defend siphon → Supply Depot Mark II-W.

targets.title: Sconce → distillery entrance → liminal space
targets.description: Banquet Hall Sconce → Juggernog lamp sequence → Distillery computer → W kills → enter painting.

targets.title: Service Bell search area & bar
targets.description: Study Bell → Overlook bar → Brain Rot zombie + ring → Flask → Distillery ritual.

targets.title: Blue distillery ritual
targets.description: W breaks the Mangler shield; defeat it and reclaim the Sentinel Artifact.

targets.title: Serpent Mound entrance, charger & P workbench
targets.description: Janus crates → Essence Bomb; two fountain Reflectors → bomb armor-side rubble → Serpent Mound.

targets.title: Two reflectors
targets.description: Reflect beam → strike source crystal → kill statue; repeat three times → Director’s Mark II-P.

targets.title: Banquet Hall portal & three chalices
targets.description: P kills → Banquet painting → Elixir → Bottlery, Overlook and Garden Pond chalices.

targets.title: Safe → purple ritual
targets.description: Wall pairs left to right → West Hallways safe → Antler → P ritual → reclaim Artifact.

targets.title: Conservatory charger & R workbench
targets.description: Conservatory: four seed defenses → Toxic Canister → Garden Pond R → Library portal.

targets.title: Library liminal-space entrance
targets.description: Aether Shroud → collect Audio Log, Ledger and ID Badge.

targets.title: Library vault & yellow ritual
targets.description: Three glowing books in confirmed order → Inspection Report → R ritual → reclaim Artifact.

targets.title: S.A.M. platform · boss start
targets.description: All three Artifacts reclaimed → upgrade, refill and activate S.A.M.’s console.

targets.title: Wunderwaffe start → orb sites → reward
targets.description: One ritual complete → laundry → book → basketball → portrait → elevator orb → Wunderwaffe.

targets.title: Service Bell search & bar
targets.description: Flask obtained → 115 bar-bell rings → random perk.

targets.title: Deer-head shotgun pedestal
targets.description: Rare Marine SP + Death Perception → deer wall → shown Field Upgrade kills → recover weapon.

targets.title: S.A.M. computer candidates & trap console
targets.description: Boot Pack-a-Punch PC → find infected upstairs PC → disk back → round/reboot → trap.

targets.title: Grandfather clock → bed
targets.description: Round 11 clock → prone on bed into round 12 → quiet footprint route → key and chest.

targets.title: Mansion jumpscare reference
targets.description: Round 13+ thermal ghost sightings → final Nursery-side window → vanity reward.

targets.title: Music headphones
targets.description: Headphones: Conservatory stairs, Banquet Hall shelf, Service Tunnel corpse.

targets.title: Hidden power-up models
targets.description: Shoot hidden models; the chandelier Fire Sale unlocks after the other seven.

filters.label: Repair the elevator & prepare your route
